license_required.quote: A license to practice public accounting shall be granted by the board to any person

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the board of accountancy created by RCW 18.04.035.

moral_character_required.quote: Who is of good character. Good character, for purposes of this section, means lack of a history of dishonest or felonious acts.

degree_required.quote: Who has met the educational standards established by rule as the board determines to be appropriate

required.quote: Who has met the experience requirements established by rule by the board as it deems appropriate

duration.quote: Who has met the experience requirements established by rule by the board as it deems appropriate, which is gained: (i) Through the use of accounting, issuing reports, management advisory, financial advisory, tax, tax advisory, or consulting skills

kind.value: accounting, auditing, management advisory, financial advisory, tax, or consulting experience
kind.quote: Through the use of accounting, issuing reports, management advisory, financial advisory, tax, tax advisory, or consulting skills

exams.name: Uniform CPA Examination
exams.notes: Board may use AICPA uniform CPA examination and advisory grading service
exams.quote: The board may make use of all or a part of the uniform certified public accountant examination and advisory grading service of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants

interval_years.quote: Three-year licenses shall be issued by the board

required.quote: an active licensee shall verify to the board that the licensee has completed at least an accumulation of one hundred twenty hours of CPE during the last three-year period to maintain the active license

hours_per_period.quote: an active licensee shall verify to the board that the licensee has completed at least an accumulation of one hundred twenty hours of CPE during the last three-year period

period_years.quote: an accumulation of one hundred twenty hours of CPE during the last three-year period to maintain the active license

topical_requirements.quote: an individual with an inactive license must verify to the board that the inactive licensee has completed a board-approved ethics course for CPE during the last three-year period to maintain the inactive license

available.quote: The board shall issue a license to a holder of a valid certificate or license issued by another state that entitles the holder to practice public accountancy

requirements.value: Reciprocal state must offer similar reciprocity; applicant must meet CPE requirements, good character requirements, and either passed the exam with passing grades or has sufficient experience; NASBA substantial equivalency designation may be accepted.
requirements.quote: Such state makes similar provision to grant reciprocity to a holder of a valid certificate or license in this state

regulatory_model.quote: No individuals may hold themselves out to the public or assume or use the designation "certified public accountant" or "CPA" or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, sign, card, or device tending to indicate that the individual is a certified public accountant or CPA unless the individual qualifies for the privileges authorized by RCW 18.04.350 or holds a license under RCW 18.04.105 and 18.04.215.

title_protection.quote: No individuals may hold themselves out to the public or assume or use the designation "certified public accountant" or "CPA" or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, sign, card, or device tending to indicate that the individual is a certified public accountant or CPA unless the individual qualifies for the privileges authorized by RCW 18.04.350 or holds a license under RCW 18.04.105 and 18.04.215.

scope_protection.quote: No firm with an office in this state may perform or offer to perform attest services as defined in RCW 18.04.025(1) or compilation services as defined in RCW 18.04.025(5) unless the firm is licensed under RCW 18.04.195

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonesty, fraud, or deceit in obtaining a license or in any filings with the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dishonesty, fraud, or deceit in obtaining a license, or in any filings with the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonesty, fraud, or negligence while representing oneself as a nonlicensee owner or licensee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dishonesty, fraud, or negligence while representing oneself as a nonlicensee owner holding an ownership interest in a licensed firm or a licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation of any provision of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of a rule of professional conduct promulgated by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation of a rule of professional conduct promulgated by the board under the authority granted by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a crime under state, other state, or federal law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a crime or an act constituting a crime under: (a) The laws of this state; (b) The laws of another state... or (c) Federal law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cancellation, revocation, suspension, or refusal to renew authority to practice as CPA by another state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cancellation, revocation, suspension, or refusal to renew the authority to practice as a certified public accountant by any other state for any cause other than failure to pay a fee or to meet the requirements of CPE in the other state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension or revocation of the right to practice before any state or federal agency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Suspension or revocation of the right to practice matters relating to public accounting before any state or federal agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain compliance with requirements for issuance, renewal, or reinstatement of a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to maintain compliance with the requirements for issuance, renewal, or reinstatement of a license, or to report changes to the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to cooperate with the board by not furnishing documents, explanations, or responding to subpoenas
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to cooperate with the board by: (a) Failure to furnish any papers or documents requested or ordered by the board; (b) Failure to furnish in writing a full and complete explanation covering the matter contained in the complaint filed with the board or the inquiry of the board; (c) Failure to respond to subpoenas issued by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure by a nonlicensee owner of a licensed firm to comply with requirements of this chapter or board rule
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure by a nonlicensee owner of a licensed firm to comply with the requirements of this chapter or board rule

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with an order of the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with an order of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performance of any fraudulent act while holding a license or privilege under this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performance of any fraudulent act while holding a license or privilege issued under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any false or misleading statement or certification in support of another's license application
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any false or misleading statement or certification, in support of an application for a license filed by another.

definition_quote.value: performing or offering to perform by a person or firm holding itself out to the public as a licensee, for a client or potential client, one or more kinds of services involving the use of accounting or auditing skills, including the issuance of "reports," or one or more kinds of management advisory, or consulting services, or the preparation of tax returns, or the furnishing of advice on tax matters
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of public accounting" means performing or offering to perform by a person or firm holding itself out to the public as a licensee, for a client or potential client, one or more kinds of services involving the use of accounting or auditing skills, including the issuance of "reports," or one or more kinds of management advisory, or consulting services, or the preparation of tax returns, or the furnishing of advice on tax matters.

value: furnishing of advice on tax matters
methods_authorized.quote: one or more kinds of services involving the use of accounting or auditing skills, including the issuance of "reports," or one or more kinds of management advisory, or consulting services, or the preparation of tax returns, or the furnishing of advice on tax matters

value: audit or other engagement in accordance with statements on auditing standards
review of a financial statement in accordance with statements on standards for accounting and review services
engagement in accordance with statements on standards for attestation engagements
engagement in accordance with public company accounting oversight board auditing standards
attest_services_types.quote: "Attest" means providing the following services: (a) Any audit or other engagement to be performed in accordance with the statements on auditing standards; (b) Any review of a financial statement to be provided in accordance with the statements on standards for accounting and review services; (c) Any engagement to be performed in accordance with the statements on standards for attestation engagements; and (d) Any engagement to be performed in accordance with the public company accounting oversight board auditing standards.

compilation_services_authorized.quote: "Compilation" means providing a service to be performed in accordance with statements on standards for accounting and review services that is presenting in the form of financial statements, information that is the representation of management (owners) without undertaking to express any assurance on the statements.

ethics_exam_required.quote: Rules specifying the registration requirements, including ethics examination and fee requirements, for resident nonlicensee partners, shareholders, and managers of licensed firms

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: no notice, fee, or other submission shall be provided by any such individual

value: consent to personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board
comply with this chapter and the board's rules
cease offering or rendering professional services if license from state of principal place of business is no longer valid
appointment of the state board which issued the certificate or license as agent upon whom process may be served
practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: Any individual licensee of another state exercising the privilege afforded under this section and the firm that employs that licensee simultaneously consent, as a condition of exercising this privilege: (a) To the personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board; (b) To comply with this chapter and the board's rules; (c) That in the event the license from the state of the individual's principal place of business is no longer valid, the individual will cease offering or rendering professional services in this state individually and on behalf of a firm; and (d) To the appointment of the state board which issued the certificate or license as their agent upon whom process may be served

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: An individual who qualifies for practice privileges under this section who performs any attest service described in RCW 18.04.025(1) may only do so through a firm which has obtained a license under RCW 18.04.195 and 18.04.215

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: A simple majority of the ownership of the firm, in terms of financial interests and voting rights of all partners, officers, shareholders, members, or managers, shall hold and renew a license to practice under RCW 18.04.105 and 18.04.215

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: Any CPA firm licensed under this chapter may include nonlicensee owners provided that the nonlicensee owner is: (a) Required to fully comply with the provisions of this chapter and board rules; (b) Required to be an individual; (c) Required to be of good character

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: The board may by rule implement a quality assurance review program as a means to monitor licensees' quality of practice and compliance with professional standards. The board may exempt from such program, licensees who undergo periodic peer reviews

peer_review_records_privileged.quote: The proceedings, records, and work papers of a review committee shall be privileged and shall not be subject to discovery, subpoena, or other means of legal process or introduction into evidence in any civil action, arbitration, administrative proceeding, or board proceeding

inactive_license_status_available.quote: Licensees in good standing may request to have their license placed on inactive status.

retired_license_status_available.quote: Rules specifying the manner and circumstances of the use of the titles "certified public accountant," "CPA," "CPA-inactive," and "CPA-retired" by holders of a license under this chapter

out_of_state_firm_no_office_exemption.quote: A firm that is not subject to the requirements of (a) of this subsection may perform compilation services described in RCW 18.04.025(5) and other nonattest professional services while using the title "CPA" or "CPA firm" in this state without a license issued under this section only if: (i) The firm performs such services through an individual with practice privileges under RCW 18.04.350

office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_requi.quote: The practice of public accounting in each office of a CPA firm established or maintained in this state shall take place under the direct supervision of a resident licensee holding a license under RCW 18.04.105 and 18.04.215

client_confidentiality_privilege.quote: A licensee or licensed firm, or any of their employees shall not disclose any confidential information obtained in the course of a professional transaction except with the consent of the client or former client or as disclosure may be required by law, legal process, the standards of the profession

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: all statements, records, schedules, working papers, and memoranda made by a licensee or licensed firm incident to or in the course of professional service to clients, except reports submitted by a licensee or licensed firm, are the property of the licensee or licensed firm.

safe_harbor_disclaimer_language_for_nonl.quote: The board may prescribe, by rule, language for the written statement describing how such financial statements were prepared for use by persons not holding a license under this chapter.

foreign_accountant_practice_exception.quote: The board shall grant a license as a certified public accountant to a holder of a permit, license, or certificate issued by a foreign country's board, agency, or institute

single_act_evidence_sufficient.quote: evidence of the commission of a single act prohibited by this chapter is sufficient to justify an injunction or a conviction without evidence of a general course of conduct.

firm_corrective_action_period_for_owners.quote: Licensed firms that fall out of compliance with the provisions of this section due to changes in firm ownership, after receiving or renewing a license, shall notify the board in writing within ninety days of its falling out of compliance and propose a time period in which they will come back into compliance. The board may grant a reasonable period of time for a firm to be in compliance with the provisions of this section.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: Any firm with an office in this state performing or offering to perform attest services as defined in RCW 18.04.025(1) or compilations as defined in RCW 18.04.025(5)

cpa_emeritus_or_retired_status_available.quote: Rules specifying the manner and circumstances of the use of the titles "certified public accountant," "CPA," "CPA-inactive," and "CPA-retired" by holders of a license under this chapter

independence_requirement_for_attest.quote: Rules of professional conduct for all licensees and nonlicensee owners of licensed firms, in order to establish and maintain high standards of competence and ethics including rules dealing with independence, integrity, objectivity, and freedom from conflicts of interest

client_records_return_obligation.quote: A licensee shall furnish to the board or to the licensee's client or former client, upon request and reasonable notice: (a) A copy of the licensee's working papers or electronic documents, to the extent that such working papers or electronic documents include records that would ordinarily constitute part of the client's records and are not otherwise available to the client; and (b) Any accounting or other records belonging to, or obtained from or on behalf of, the client
